rows.basis: Per the thesis, the FY2025 10-K (Item 1) describes a fixed-price PPA to supply AWS up to 1,920 MW from Susquehanna through 2042, reaching full volume no later than 2032. No revenue under it is stated for the year, and the roughly $18B lifetime contract value is not revenue in the year. This is contracted power to a data-center customer, not AI revenue, and the PJM segment is a market line, not a data-center line.
